data.one_liner: Integrate EaseMob IM global instant messaging services into Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to integrate one-to-one chat, group chat, chat rooms, and other instant messaging features into a Flutter application. It uses a federated plugin architecture supporting Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to build instant messaging capabilities like one-to-one or group chats in your app.
You are using the EaseMob IM backend services.
avoid_when: You require password-based client login, as version 5.0.0 only supports token-based login managed by your server.
You are looking for an open-source self-hosted chat backend without third-party dependencies.
strengths: High reliability, ultra-low latency, and high concurrency IM support.
Federated plugin architecture cleanly separating platform implementations.
weaknesses: Requires an EaseMob IM developer account and server-side infrastructure for token generation.
Version 5.0.0 contains significant breaking changes requiring updates to login flows and read receipts.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum SDK versions (API 21 for Android, iOS 13), ProGuard keep rules on Android, an EaseMob developer account, and configuring app keys.
